title: Symphony in Gold
description: Aged bourbon, honey, ginger. Experience the symphony of flavors as aged bourbon blends seamlessly with the sweetness of honey & the subtle spice of ginger.

title: Enchanted Elixir
description: Berries, vodka, elderflower. Let the enchantment unfold as you savor the magical blend of muddled berries, premium vodka, and a hint of elderflower liqueur.

title: Raspberry Caipirinha
description: Cachaça, fresh raspberries, lime, sugar. A vibrant spin on the Brazilian classic — muddled raspberries and lime with crystalline sugar, shaken with premium cachaça for a sweet-tart burst of summer in every sip.

title: Blackberry Bramble
description: Gin, blackberry liqueur, lemon, sugar. A sophisticated garden gem — smooth gin mingled with dark blackberry liqueur, fresh lemon juice, and a touch of sugar, crowned with plump fresh berries for a perfectly balanced sweet-tangy finish.

title: Ginger Grapefruit Fizz
description: Gin, grapefruit juice, ginger syrup, soda. A zesty and invigorating blend — smooth gin meets sharp pink grapefruit and warm ginger syrup, topped with sparkling soda for a crisp, refreshing kick with a spicy citrus glow.

title: Blue Margarita
description: Tequila, blue curaçao, lime juice, triple sec. A mesmerizing azure twist on the classic — premium tequila balanced with vibrant blue curaçao, fresh lime, and orange liqueur, served over ice with a salted rim for a crisp, citrusy escape.

title: Mojito
description: White rum, fresh mint, lime, sugar, soda. A timeless Cuban classic — muddled mint and lime with cane sugar, shaken with light rum and topped with bubbly soda for an effervescent burst of herbal freshness.

title: Mezcal Mule
description: Mezcal, ginger beer, lime, agave. A smoky twist on the Moscow Mule — bold mezcal with spicy ginger beer, fresh lime, and a touch of agave, served in a copper mug for a fiery, earthy kick.

title: Piña Colada
description: White rum, coconut cream, pineapple juice. A creamy Caribbean dream — silky coconut and sweet pineapple blended with premium rum, served chilled with a pineapple wedge for an instant tropical getaway.

title: Espresso Martini
description: Vodka, coffee liqueur, fresh espresso. A sophisticated after-dinner classic — rich espresso mingled with smooth vodka and dark coffee liqueur, shaken until velvety and topped with three coffee beans for good luck.

title: Mezcal Paloma
description: Mezcal, grapefruit soda, lime, agave. A smoky-sweet Mexican favorite — mezcal's earthy depth meets tangy grapefruit soda and fresh lime, balanced with agave nectar for a rustic, sunset-inspired refresher.

title: Elderflower Spritz
description: Prosecco, elderflower liqueur, soda, mint. An effervescent garden bouquet — crisp prosecco and delicate elderflower liqueur topped with soda, garnished with fresh mint for a light, floral, and utterly elegant sip.

title: Passionfruit Caipiroska
description: Vodka, passionfruit, lime, sugar. A luscious Brazilian-inspired cooler — fresh passionfruit pulp and lime muddled with sugar, shaken with smooth vodka for a tangy, exotic burst of tropical sunshine.
